description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for handling article detail retrieval via a CQRS pattern with MediatR. It includes a request query, a validator for the query, and a handler that fetches article data from the database and handles not found errors.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Encapsulates the request with a Slug property identifying the article

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug in the query is not null or empty

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the request by fetching article data from the database and returning an envelope or throwing an error if not found

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to retrieve the article by slug and handle errors
